title: Chapter 952
text:
Manison was all too familiar with the Mechanical Deity. This was his trump card, and it had been many years since an opponent had been able to force him to use it. Now that he suddenly saw that Han Xiao also had this power, his emotions were in turmoil.

Previously, Manison was still doubtful, but now, he could finally confirm that Black Star had truly reached his level!

"Unbelievable … This growth speed …"

Manison's eyes were filled with shock.

In terms of the age of a Beyond Grade A, Black Star was too young, so young to the point of immaturity. However, why was he able to break through common sense and become so strong in just a few years, completing what other Beyond Grade As had taken decades to accumulate?

Was it really because of his talent?

Since ancient times, no one had ever had such terrifying potential. Manison clearly remembered that the last time he sparred with Black Star, the Mechanical Sense talent displayed by Black Star was clearly very embarrassing. It even made people wonder if he was a fake Beyond Grade A.

If it was not because of his talent, what other reason could it be?

Manison suddenly had an idea.

Could it be … that Black Star had other Universal Treasures other than the Evolution Cube and the Spacetime Amber?

"No matter what, this growth speed is too strange. There must be something strange about it. Black Star must have some unknown secret …"

Thinking of this, Manison suddenly had a strong desire.

If possible, he really wanted to dissect Black Star and find out the truth.

Suppressing the impulse in his heart, Manison's eyes flickered, and he secretly thought of a question.

"Black Star already has the power of the Mechanical Deity. Then … did he discover the secret of the Machinery Faith?"

Normal Beyond Grade As did not have an interface and were unable to completely understand all of their own data. They could only explore the use of their various abilities. Therefore, not all Divine Throne Mechanics could discover the special effect of the [Key of Adeptus Mechanicus].

If not for the knowledge passed down by the Mechanical Race, Manison was not sure if he would have been able to discover the bonuses brought by the believers of the Machinery Faith.

The question now was, did Black Star discover this ability?

All along, Manison had been spreading the name 'Mecha Empire', occupying almost all the believers of the Machinery Faith and obtaining huge bonuses from it.

If Black Star also discovered this point, he would definitely become his competitor and an obstacle on his path!

At this moment, the importance of Black Star in his heart had risen to the highest level!

"I need to pay more attention to him …" Manison narrowed his eyes, his face expressionless.

…

"Oh my god! It's so huge! "

"I, I actually want to worship it. Is this normal?"

The Mecha Of Mech Legion's appearance, and the countless galactic residents present had a look of shock on their faces.

Of course, to compare to it was to the size to to the Tyrant was to the size was to the size Gigantic was to the size was to the Tyrant with it was like an ant.

Not only was it huge, but the Mechanical Deity also exuded a powerful aura, making everyone who saw it have the urge to kneel down and worship it.

Its appearance could be constantly changed, and the specifics were controlled by Han Xiao's consciousness. The Mechanical Deity was a huge silver-black mechanical sphere, like an egg. Countless nanoparticles and mechanical structures flowed on its surface, filled with the beauty and weight of machinery.

Under Han Xiao's control, the head, arms, and legs extended out from the 'egg', and the Mechanical Deity turned into a humanoid structure. The nanoparticles on its face turned into facial features, looking like Han Xiao himself. It looked like a giant version of Black Star that had been enlarged countless times.

Inside the body, all the independent mechanical soldiers were turned into parts of the Mechanical Deity. The Mechanical Force chains were attached to all the mechanical soldiers, forming intricate energy transmission pipes in the body. They were also used to control the movements of this big guy, acting like a nerve center.

The Mechanical Deity had the functions of every combined mechanical soldier, and it could be used on any part of the body through nanoparticles. Furthermore, the effects were greatly stacked.

For example, if one fused 100,000 shield generators, the Mechanical Deity could also use 100,000 shields to protect every corner of its body. It could also fuse and stack psionic shields to form extremely thick shields.

Han Xiao's physical senses extended to every corner of the Mechanical Deity's body, as if this was his original body.

"This feeling is not bad."

This was the first time Han Xiao had used this ability, so it was quite novel.

The Mechanical Deity lowered its towering head and looked down at the planet. Its vision passed through the sea of clouds and locked onto the incomparably tiny Tyrant.

Its huge right palm was raised, and it slapped down like a mountain falling from the sky.

The palm broke through the atmosphere, and flames appeared at the edge of the palm. Its shadow covered a large area, blocking all of Heber's vision.

Rumble!

The sound of the air breaking was like the sky was falling!

Heber's expression was ferocious. He gritted his teeth and got rid of the shock in his heart. He pushed his palms toward the sky, and highly condensed Pugilist waves shot out from his palms.

"Star Shattering Pestle!"

Hum!

With Heber's palms as the center, a red-gold halo with a diameter of tens of meters popped out horizontally. The Pugilist waves expanded and turned into a thick red-gold beam of light with a diameter of tens of meters, shooting toward the rapidly descending palm of the Mechanical Deity!

The thick Pugilist flames were like streams of mist, rising around the light beam. It was so thick that it looked like it was about to liquefy. The light beam with a diameter of tens of meters was not considered thin, but against the mountain-sized palm of the Mechanical Deity, the image was like a toothpick poking into a person's palm.

Clack!

A large number of mechanical parts moved on the palm of the Mechanical Deity, quickly transforming into dense shield generators. Countless psionic shields were activated, connected, and stacked together, forming a super-large psionic shield that covered the entire palm. It was like a huge gradual blue bubble.

The next moment, the red-gold beam of light arrived in the blink of an eye and hit the palm of the Mechanical Deity.

Boom!

A hurricane that swept everything suddenly rose, and the golden shockwave spread rapidly, sweeping across half of the planet's surface. The clouds were scattered, and the crust was lifted!

Even in space, the golden energy ripples produced by this shockwave were visible to the naked eye.

The huge chain reaction explosion energy cluster expanded, shattering a large number of psionic shields. The mechanical parts on the surface of the palm melted on a large scale, and flaming red spots appeared. However, the palm of the Mechanical Deity did not stop at all. It continued to press down as if it was holding the explosion energy cluster and smashing it down!

Heber kept increasing the output of his Pugilist waves. The veins all over his body bulged, and the muscle fibers on his arms burst one after another, dripping with blood.

However, it was as if he did not feel any pain. His bloodshot eyes stared at the rapidly expanding palm of the Mechanical Deity in his sight. He crazily squeezed out all the energy in his body, releasing all the energy waves through his hands as if he was going to face the palm head-on!

The red-gold beam of light quickly shortened, and the palm of the Mechanical Deity finally smashed into the ground.

At this moment, Heber's vision was only left with a vast expanse of white.

Boom!

The palm of the Mechanical Deity slammed into the planet and continued to penetrate deep into the ground, forming a deep palm print. The explosion energy cluster was directly stuffed into the depths of the planet's crust.

Cracks appeared on the ground, and dazzling light shot out from the cracks. In an instant, the vibrating sound waves that were enough to kill countless ordinary people exploded on the surface of the planet.

The next moment, the light cluster expanded completely, and an earth-shattering explosion occurred in the depths of the planet, directly blowing up half of the planet!

The shattered continental plates broke away from the planet's gravity and turned into meteorites. The liquid core in the depths of the planet was exposed, and high-temperature magma and star core material were spewed into space. The dazzling red liquid material quickly cooled and solidified, turning into irregularly shaped black rock plates that drifted in the universe!

In the blink of an eye, Black Star Ba's appearance seemed to have turned into an apple with a piece removed!

However, this situation did not last long. The star core that had lost its balance quickly collapsed, and the planet collapsed inward. The second round of explosion occurred.

Boom!

The star core expanded and turned into a huge explosion of light. All the materials that made up the planet were thrown out, and the entire planet was torn apart!

With one slap, Black Star Ba was directly crushed!

The energy shockwave of the planet's explosion swept out and affected the crowd watching the battle from afar.

The shockwave swept through the formation of the audience, and the spaceships shook one after another. All of them popped up their stress shields.

"Black Star Ba … exploded!"

Although the galactic residents watching the battle in space could not hear anything, it did not stop them from imagining this earth-shattering scene. Countless people instinctively trembled in front of this terrifying scene, and some even almost lost control of their bowels on the spot.

This explosion also affected the Mechanical Deity. The psionic shield array that covered the Mechanical Deity was like a dense shield wall, but at this time, a large area was shattered, and large areas of melting appeared on the surface of the Mechanical Deity.

However, the next moment, nanoparticles flowed on the surface of the Mechanical Deity, repairing the damage. Because of the loss of a lot of materials, the Mechanical Deity shrunk slightly, but its size was still huge.

The many galactic residents present could not help but gulp and stretch their necks to look for traces of Heber.

"Where's the Tyrant?"

"Could he have been killed by the explosion …"

"It can't be, right? He can use his body to smash through a planet. The explosion of a planet can't kill him … right?"

At this time, the battlefield became a large newly formed asteroid belt. Han Xiao glanced around and did not find any traces of Heber, so he simply looked at the interface.

In the combat information, Heber's health had decreased by a large amount. If not for his True Damage Immunity and fixed damage reduction, this would have taken away half of his life. Now, his injuries were also very serious, but he still had the ability to fight.

It looked like a slap, but in fact, this attack contained a lot of mixed damage. It contained a large amount of psionic impact damage, the explosion damage from Heber's own trump card, and the large amount of shockwave damage from the palm. Furthermore, the Mechanical Deity had countless power output devices, and the Mechanical Force bonus was even more shocking, comparable to the legendary Galactic Titans. Therefore, the power of this attack was extremely terrifying, causing a chain reaction on the planet.

Of course, this powerful attack was accompanied by a large amount of energy consumption. If not for Han Xiao's energy regeneration talent, the Mechanical Deity would have become Ultraman and could only fight for three minutes.

Han Xiao was looking for traces of the Tyrant when suddenly, he felt a pain in the right arm of the Mechanical Deity. A series of explosions occurred from the inside out, and the initiator was none other than Heber.

"So, he took advantage of my slap to send himself into the right arm of the Mechanical Deity, wanting to destroy this huge body from the inside?"

Han Xiao shook his head slightly.

The Tyrant's choice did indeed seem to be the most correct strategy. Most people thought that the huge mechanical structure was very cumbersome, and its weakness was the inside.

However, for a Mechanical Deity that could transform any part of its body, this rule did not apply.

…

There were mechanical parts all around, and the heavily injured Heber was wantonly destroying the inside of the right arm of the Mechanical Deity, smashing through all the structures along the way and charging straight into the depths of the Mechanical Deity.

However, at this time, the internal structure of the arm deformed, and mechanical soldiers quickly assembled, using the inside of the arm as a battlefield. They rushed up and fought with Heber, hanging onto Heber's huge body one after another.

"Scram!" Heber was enraged, and his protective energy exploded, sending all the mechanical soldiers clinging onto him flying.

Just as he was about to continue charging forward, his feet suddenly sank, and the mechanical structure below him suddenly turned into a trap, biting onto half of Heber's body and locking him in place.

Countless mechanical tentacles shot out from all directions, wrapping around Heber in circles. These tentacles were made of nano-materials, using a self-created synthetic material. They had no other advantage other than being very strong, and they were specifically used as ropes.

Immediately after, the structure around him changed again, turning into different mechanical devices. Electromagnetic chains, Molecular Oscillation, Gravity Multiplication, Space Distortion, and many other control abilities were released at the same time, all acting on Heber.

Heber instantly felt like he had fallen into a swamp. Not only did he feel dizzy, but his movements also became extremely difficult.

At the same time, psionic cannon nozzles appeared in all directions, all aimed at Heber, and without a word, all of them landed on Heber's mountain-like body.

It was a good idea to attack the Mechanical Deity from the inside, but entering the body of the Mechanical Deity was equivalent to stepping into the home field of the Mechanics, walking right into the trap!

Heber was dizzy from the explosion, and his rage was almost maxed out. With a roar, he ignored all restrictions and punched toward the depths of the Mechanical Deity's arm.

"Star Shaking Punch!"

Rumble —

A reddish-gold beam shot out, penetrating all the mechanical structures along the way and going deeper into the Mechanical Deity's arm.

However, just as the beam reached the elbow, a psionic shield wall blocked the path of the Star Shaking Punch, and the Star Shaking Punch smashed into it.

Bang!

With a flash of light, countless parts were blown away, and the right arm of the Mechanical Deity was severed from the elbow!

Heber was also sent flying, tumbling in the universe. His eyes swept over this scene, and his spirits were instantly lifted.

However, before he could get excited, the severed right arm suddenly disintegrated, turning back into mechanical soldiers. Immediately after, dense chains of Mechanical Force shot out from the severed arm of the Mechanical Deity, sticking to these mechanical soldiers like a spider web and pulling them back.

The next moment, the scattered mechanical soldiers gathered again, and the right arm of the Mechanical Deity was reconstructed!

Heber's expression froze.

"Only a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist has a chance of breaking the Mechanical Deity from the inside …" Han Xiao took a deep breath. "You're not strong enough!"

He did not plan to let the Tyrant rest. Suddenly, countless psionic cannon nozzles appeared in front of the Mechanical Deity, focusing their fire on Heber.

While attacking from a distance, countless thrusters appeared on the back of the Mechanical Deity. Dense exhaust flames spurted out from the back of the Mechanical Deity, pushing its huge body toward the Tyrant!

The huge fist did not seem to have a high hit rate, but when Heber dodged the fist, the closest part would become a psionic cannon or a new mechanical weapon to attack, and any part of his body could transform at any time.

No matter how he dodged, he would still be hit. The only difference was what kind of attack he would be hit by.

After barely blocking for a while, Heber could not take it anymore. He was beaten up crazily by the Mechanical Deity, becoming a sandbag that was thrown around.

When the spectators saw this, they understood the situation.

They originally thought that Heber would be able to turn the situation around, but he was still completely suppressed by Black Star. From the looks of it, there was nothing he could do.

At this moment, the image of Heber being trampled by Han Xiao was imprinted in everyone's heart, and they would never forget it.

The domineering image in the hearts of the Shattered Star Ring citizens was shattered.
